description: Small normalized analysis dataset derived from preserved official NHL source responses. No raw API responses, credentials, database dumps, or machine-local paths are included.
reproduction_boundary: Regenerates era-adjusted career features, eligible pools, weighted rankings, nearest-match diagnostics and article graphics from normalized player/season counts. Fetching or reparsing upstream raw responses and repeating the warehouse audit are separate source-validation steps, not required for offline article reproduction.

grains.bundle.players: One stable NHL player ID with preserved NHL regular-season team-season records. Legitimate traded-player team stints are intentionally combined by the analysis; source rows are never attributed to a permanent team.
grains.bundle.roster: One stable NHL player ID listed by the frozen COL/current endpoint on November 10, 2026; includes listed injured players.
grains.bundle.league: One NHL regular season, with the recorded league environment and team schedule exposure.
grains.bundle.era_environments: One NHL regular season, with league-wide all-team goal/assist counts and team-game exposure.
grains.scoring: One combined-team skater/player regular season, restricted to the 228 preserved career-player IDs; PP points are not team-attributed.
grains.pp_rates: One NHL regular season; league skater PP points divided by league team-games.
grains.ice_time: One skater/player regular season that passed the total-minute and matching-games audit; seconds are shorthanded. Missing or failed-audit seasons are absent, never zero-filled.
grains.goalie_saved.player_seasons: One goalie/player regular season, intentionally combined over legitimate team stints and checked against complete career totals.
grains.goalie_saved.league_seasons: One regular season, aggregated from unique all-team goalie/player seasons.
grains.goalie_quality.player_seasons: One goalie/player regular season; official fixed-.900-threshold quality-start count with matching appearances/starts.
grains.goalie_quality.league_seasons: One regular season, aggregated from unique all-team goalie/player seasons, with league starts and quality starts.

derivation: Retain normalized public player histories, stable NHL IDs, biographical dates needed for the separate age comparison, Colorado eligibility appearances, and the frozen roster.

Retain only the selected separate-goal/assist era configuration, reference rates, and league environments; omit abandoned-method metadata and league-wide season-relative experimental peer rows because the selected method does not use them.
Validate all source PP rows against the complete era peer extraction before restricting player-season PP records to the preserved career-player IDs; retain the full-league PP rate for every season.
Keep only PK seasons with agreement in the preserved total-minute audit; unavailable or disagreeing special-teams minutes remain missing.
Validate goalie landing/summary counts and full-window quality-start coverage; retain selected player counts and league seasonal aggregates rather than thousands of raw league-player report rows.
Apply the user-selected 82/50 Colorado-game eligibility cutoffs in the portable configuration without modifying the frozen parent snapshots.

coverage.eligibility_source: Official NHL team-filtered regular-season aggregate (teamId=21 since1995); warehouse played appearances retained as incomplete crosscheck.
coverage.roster_definition: Official COL/current endpoint; includes listed injured players; not a guarantee of active-game eligibility.
coverage.historical_ice_time: The verified 1986-87 through 1994-95 NHL time-on-ice responses contain null total, PP and PK minute fields. Successful download does not establish usable minutes. No missing PK minutes have been replaced with zero.

definition.threshold: Start with save percentage greater than .900, per NHL published explanation; fixed threshold is not era-neutral.
